description: This file defines classes related to creating and managing references to Orleans grains, including activators for typed and untyped grains, a provider for proxy types, and mechanisms for instantiating grain references with appropriate configurations.

classes.name: GrainReferenceActivator
classes.description: Central class for creating GrainReference instances based on grain ID and interface type, caching activators.

classes.name: UntypedGrainReferenceActivatorProvider
classes.description: Provider for activators for grains without specific interfaces, producing untyped GrainReference objects.

classes.name: UntypedGrainReferenceActivator
classes.description: Activator for grain references without a specified grain interface, creating references directly from grain IDs.

classes.name: RpcProvider
classes.description: Manages mapping from GrainInterfaceType to generated proxy types for RPC calls.

classes.name: GrainReferenceActivatorProvider
classes.description: Creates grain references using generated proxy objects Type, supports configurable unordered invocation.

methods.name: CreateReference
methods.description: Method in GrainReferenceActivator to create a GrainReference for a given GrainId.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a generated proxy type for a given GrainInterfaceType in RpcProvider.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to get an activator for a specific GrainType and GrainInterfaceType.
